rules.catalog: Preserve every original published slot as separate occurrence. Eligible SPUR requires separate evidence. Enumerate all150m physical-curb path regions; uncovered counterpasses remain unknown barriers. Reviewed traversal-only masks need independent provenance. Catalog masks intersect150m phase regions without changing actual75m curb gate.
rules.confirmation: Two distinct eligible live observations >=9000ms apart, same independently current eligible occurrence+ordinal, both named the same stop within75m. At most one live witness per observed fix.
rules.deadlines: Set enrolledAt=forecastAt (forecast creation); keep actual boundAt separately. Expire FIRST on every packet/bind/confirmation/tick when actual available time >forecastAt+2820000ms; exact deadline allowed. First observed arrival wait must lie in inclusive[0,2700000ms]. Delayed binding never restarts47min. Late phase/confirmation cannot rescue, including with no intermediate tick. Logical cutoff is separate from actual terminal availability.
rules.enrollment: Process raw/proxy evidence before forecast enrollment. Both next-phase proof availability and current raw/encounter ledger prefix availability must be <=forecastAt; later phase cannot bind an old forecast. Unknown/refused opportunities remain diagnostic forever and cannot retry into a later encounter. Reject any promise once first curb evidence is known. Bind exactly one encounter/horizon; all horizons share the same global encounter/event cluster.
rules.geometry: Pure raw polyline projection with all forward reachable intervals and fixed40m/s bound. Conventional Earth radius6371000m; no heading/lastStop selection. Keep all branches; capacity overflow invalidates/censors, never trims.
rules.independence: Outcome modules accept explicit raw GPS/curb allowlist and independent catalog. No estimator/forecast/belief/ETA/travel/index/trained tables. Full packet hashes stay in external custody; core evidence hashes use stripped raw payloads and source/availability clocks.
rules.liveGate: public-current,frameCount0,hasMorefalse,cursor==latest; observedAt<=originalReceivedAt<=actualConsumerAvailableAt; absolute age<=30000ms against both receipt/consumer clocks; stationarytrue,namedcurb<=75m.
rules.liveProvenance: Every receipt is retained before filters. Historical/frame>0 can advance raw phase but cannot confirm/enroll. A later caught-up live0 identical fix may upgrade witness provenance once at actual availability without becoming another observed clock.
rules.namespace: New exclusive manifest/namespace, separate input/output ledger and actual prospective cutoff after qualification; publicationCapability=false hardcoded. Qualification fixtures use fixtureMode=true and cannot become real support. No import/invocation/config change in current learning-loop or production.
rules.passage: Require all branches past the same reviewed region exit and fresh raw point strictly beyond150m. Persist passedThrough per occurrence so later opposite/lap proximity cannot revive an encounter. Advance ordinals even without confirmation.
rules.queries: queryCurrentEncounter authorizes both curb witnesses only at the currently occupied eligible occurrence and ordinal. queryNextEncounter is enrollment-only. All surviving branches must agree occurrence AND ordinal; any potentially earlier unknown service blocks binding.
rules.rawObservationIdentity: Exact source epoch,routeId,busId,busName,observedAt; GPS core hash covers lat/lon/stationary/atStopId. Heading/speed/operatorLastStop stay audit-only outside pure outcome reducer. Same-clock differing GPS core is conflict, never two fixes.
rules.seed: Only one proper connected modulo-loop uncertainty component may seed. Lift seam-connected aliases once into a common generation; retain full interval. Never normalize genuine postseed lap alternatives. No retroactive forecast enrollment.
rules.sourceContinuity: Source epoch/vehicle/catalog/protocol change, missing bus, conflict, live clock/cursor regression or source cursor jump>1 censors open continuity before any reseed. Same source cursor may repeat. Historical/reordered input never retroactively binds a forecast. Distinct-observed or actual-consumer receipt gap>30000ms invalidates; equality allowed.
rules.terminals: Confirmed,passed-unconfirmed,deadline,identity/source/gap/conflict censored terminal states are immutable. Later evidence produces separate diagnostics, never relabels/rebinds.

scope: Independent GPS curb proxy; never door/service truth or automatic model publication
